{{Top|leg}}
'''Mining Machine No. 9''' was one of hundreds of similar constructions on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] related to mining [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from underground, started up by industrialists representing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was a complex of barracks and driller garages located south of the capital city of [[Thousand Thousand]].

At the complex, rocks plunged downward into a deep pit, cutting across spice veins and ore deposits, eventually curving into a half-moon canyon, seventy-five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long.

The [[Congress of Caliphs]] would often receive a percentage of the profits from the mines. During uprisings of the [[Temple of the Beatific Razor]], many of these machines were victimized due to their off-world allegiances to the Republic, and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
